title: Modern Apple Cows
description: Adding the cutest Apple Cows out there!
body: ![Apple Cows!](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/h3VCF7si/images/6daf7f35f09103d2fe1e1259c33c3508f830550b.png) ## **What is Modern Apple Cows?** Modern Apple cows is a simple mod that adds Apple Cows, Golden Apple Cows, and very rare Enchanted Golden Apple Cows. They can be sheared and they even take naps!! This is a standalone mod of the Apple Cow feature in [Antarchy](https://modrinth.com/mod/antarchy) for those who just want the cows. They have a very cute, animated, and modern look to then. *** Join the [discord if you have any other questions!](https://discord.com/invite/72a7jmc5mb) *** ## **Credits** **CraisinLord:** Creator, coding **Karlljp**: The beautiful apple cows you see in the mod! *** ## **Support Us** I like paying artists well, so I personally spent a lot of money on this project. Any money I get from my Patreon or Bisect goes right back into adding more content into the mod :)
